title: Account security
intro: Protect your Jekimo account with an authenticator app.
optional: Two-factor authentication is optional on this instance. You can enable it for your account.
required: Your instance admin requires two-factor authentication for everyone. Set it up to continue.
unconfigured: The instance operator must configure the MFA encryption key before authenticator setup is available.
remaining: {count, plural, one {# recovery code remaining} other {# recovery codes remaining}}
policyIntro: Require every user to enroll before they can access projects. When this is off, users may still opt in and existing authenticators stay enabled.
policyOn: Two-factor authentication is required for everyone.
policyOff: Users can choose whether to enable two-factor authentication.
enrollFirst: Enable two-factor authentication on your own account before changing this policy.
setupIntro: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key manually. Then enter a current six-digit code. Setup expires after 10 minutes.
codesIntro: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator. They will not be shown again. Generating a new set invalidates the old set.
confirmIntro: Confirm your current password and, when requested, an unused authenticator or recovery code.
disableWarning: This removes the extra protection from your account and signs out your other sessions.
regenerateWarning: This replaces every old recovery code and signs out your other sessions.
policyWarning: This policy takes effect on existing sessions as well as new sign-ins.
enabledNotice: Two-factor authentication is enabled. Other sessions have been signed out.
